meta.name: GoVenture
meta.refresh_cadence: quarterly — product-only benchmark, low expected rate of change; not worth a tighter cadence given thin public footprint

snapshot.one_liner: Long-running series of educational business/entrepreneurship simulation games and curriculum (business, entrepreneurship, marketing, accounting, leadership, financial literacy), spanning software sims and tabletop/board games.
snapshot.why_they_compete: Strong match on the game and course-embedded axis, per COMPETITORS.md (#5 of 10).

positioning.value_prop: 'Easier teaching and deeper, faster learning through simulated practice' — emphasizes reducing instructor workload via automated assessment/real-time feedback and 100+ microlearning modules.
positioning.differentiation: A level-up business progression: players start at a lemonade stand and progress up to full businesses (restaurant, gym, hotel, etc.); ADA 508-compliant/accessible design.

1_identity.audience_icp: K-12 teachers, university professors, corporate trainers; students across ability levels including at-risk/gifted/special-needs populations.

similarity_to_us.rationale: High similarity on the game-plus-curriculum axis; explicit accessibility focus and K-12 depth are differentiators from Altitut. Directional judgment, not a scoring model.

highlight_features.feature: Level-up business progression (lemonade stand → full business)
highlight_features.why_pushed: Core pedagogical/gamification mechanic — a concrete difficulty curve.
Reduces instructor grading workload — a direct B2B (teacher) pain point.

most_attractive_features.why_it_lands: A concrete, escalating difficulty curve (lemonade stand to full business) that mirrors game-design skill-tree pacing.

messaging_conversion.pricing: Verbatim structure: Student Account Subscriptions priced per number of accounts (purchased in multiples of 5, 1-year term, reassignable); Site/Perpetual License (one-time payment, unlimited use at one school, ~1yr free upgrades); a 'Suite' option (low yearly fee vs. higher upfront perpetual cost). Exact dollar amounts require a quote.
messaging_conversion.funnel_path: not available — quote-based B2B sales motion to schools/institutions.

insights_to_imbibe: The 'level-up' business progression (lemonade stand → kiosk → food truck → full business) is a concrete gamified-difficulty-curve model Altitut's RPG framing could borrow directly for skill-tree pacing.
